title: Wandrd’s Magnetic Camera Straps Are My New Favorite Accessory

claims.claim: Wandrd launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.

evidence.quote: Wandrd—known for its camera bags—launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.

claims.claim: Wandrd's Torus Links anchors are rated to carry up to 198 pounds.

evidence.quote: The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job.
The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds

claims.claim: Wandrd offers a two-year warranty for the strap system.

evidence.quote: (Wandrd offers a two-year warranty.)

claims.claim: Wandrd spent two years developing its custom liquid nylon tubular webbing.

evidence.quote: Cope says Wandrd spent two years developing this custom “liquid nylon” tubular webbing that is softer along the edges
Cope says Wandrd spent two years developing this custom “liquid nylon” tubular webbing

claims.claim: Wandrd is selling a DIY kit for $29 that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.

evidence.quote: If you have a strap you love—maybe a fancy leather strap someone gifted you—Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.
Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.

claims.claim: The strap kit comes in a 30-mm size priced at $69.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69)

claims.claim: The strap kit includes a 15-mm Lite version priced at $49.

evidence.quote: a 15-mm “Lite
a 15-mm “Lite" ($49)

claims.claim: The wrist strap from Wandrd is priced at $39.
